text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fosphenytoin sodium inventory across the system provides approximately 17 to 24 days on hand. Corvale East holds 121 units at 7 per day for 17 days. Corvale General holds 141 units at 8.1 per day for 17 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 54 units at 2.2 per day for 24 days. The Sagent Pharmaceuticals label names the GLAND plant as the manufacturing site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list fosphenytoin sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current supply covers less than one month at most sites. No national shortage is posted, but the single-source manufacturing reference on the Sagent label creates concentration risk. Alternative manufacturers are available but not yet qualified for our formulary.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to request allocation data and lead times from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc. USA, Gland Pharma Limited, and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.; buyer approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer to verify manufacturing site disclosures for each alternative supplier; buyer approves vendor qualification.
3. Pharmacy director to review and approve interim formulary additions for any qualified alternative; pharmacy director approves.
4. P&T committee to ratify any formulary changes at next scheduled meeting; P&T committee approves.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic substitutions or protocol changes before alternative supply is secured and committee review occurs.
